title: Composition
description: Rule of thirds, visual balance, leading lines, and intentional framing to give each image depth and direction.
detail: I place the subject on a third intersection and let lines carry the eye into the scene. Foreground framing and space around the subject give the eye a clear path through the photograph.

title: Light & Exposure
description: High-contrast natural light, deep shadow, and atmospheric tones handled with a calm, deliberate exposure.
detail: I expose for the highlights I want to keep and let the shadows fall away. Watching how light changes across a scene helps me choose the moment, balance the exposure, and preserve its atmosphere.

title: Post-Processing
description: Contrast, highlight recovery, and color grading used to reinforce the mood already present in the scene.
detail: Edits stay small and consistent: contrast, highlight recovery, and a color grade that reinforces the mood already in the scene. I look at the whole set together so the photographs share a coherent tone.

title: Camera Control
description: Action tracking, panning, and intentional motion blur balanced with a sharp, purposeful subject.
detail: I track the subject, slow the shutter, and pan with its movement, aiming to keep the subject sharp as the background turns into streaks. Shutter speed and a steady follow-through determine how much movement stays in the frame.

title: Storytelling
description: Frames chosen and ordered so a set reads as a sequence: the wide establishing shot, the detail, the closing beat.
detail: I shoot for the edit: one wide frame to establish the place, a few details to give it texture, and a closing frame that lets the set breathe. Changes in scale and pace help a collection carry the feeling of being there.
